threads.body: [Testing] This test doesn’t currently exercise constructor handling in the actual `@AddingSpanAttributes` instrumentation path. `AddingSpanAttributesInstrumentation.typeMatcher()` uses `declaresMethod(@AddingSpanAttributes)` (i.e., it won’t even transform types that only have an annotated constructor), so `ConstructedWithAddingSpanAttributes` (constructor-only) will be skipped and the assertion can pass trivially. To make this a meaningful regression test, consider using a class that is eligible for transformation (e.g., add at least one `@AddingSpanAttributes`-annotated method to `ConstructedWithAddingSpanAttributes`, or reuse an existing eligible test class) and then verify the annotated constructor still doesn’t add attributes / doesn’t break instrumentation.

threads.body: `TestAgentListenerAccess.reset()` clears `instrumentationErrorCount` and other listener state. Since `AgentTestRunner.afterTestClass()` asserts `getInstrumentationErrorCount() == 0` at the end of the class, resetting inside a single test can mask instrumentation errors that happened earlier in this test class and reduce CI signal. Prefer not calling `reset()` here; it should be enough to add a narrowly-scoped skip condition (typeName check) and let the per-test-class reset in the runner handle cleanup.
